question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. 

A group of fish
solution:
The correct answer is: **Shoal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Point__

 
• **A group of fish is called a School or Shoal.**

​1) Troop: A group of soldiers.

2) Bunch: A group of things.

3) Litter: A group of small animals.

4) Shoal: A group of fish.

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**

3e
